provenance: Self-authored source executed on isolated original virtual HP Prime G1 firmware 2.4.2 revision 15751. No physical device used. Scalar/text results retain calculator output. Chart coordinates and styles are transcribed from inspected actual framebuffers, with explicit PPL data and bounds; this does not establish pixel-identical Native rendering.

controls.source: EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; D3:={10,20,40}; SetSample(H2,D3); RETURN STRING({H1,H2,NbItem,MeanX}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN RETURN STRING({Do1VStats(H1),NbItem,MeanX}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL a,b; a:=STRING({NbItem,MeanX}); Do1VStats(H2); b:=STRING({NbItem,MeanX}); RETURN STRING({a,b}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL a,b; a:=STRING({NbItem,MeanX}); Do1VStats(H2); b:=STRING({NbItem,MeanX}); RETURN STRING({a,b}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL a,b; a:=STRING({NbItem,MeanX}); Do1VStats(H1); b:=STRING({NbItem,MeanX}); RETURN STRING({a,b}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={100,200,400}; RETURN STRING({Do1VStats(H2),NbItem,MeanX,D1,D3}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1; IFERR Do1VStats(H5); THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({ok,NbItem,MeanX}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1; SetFreq(H2,-1); D1:={1000,2000,4000}; IFERR Do1VStats(H1); THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({ok,NbItem,MeanX}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1; IFERR MeanX:=99; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({ok,MeanX}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=2; H1(4):=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=3; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=4; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=5; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=6; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=7; H1(4):=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=8; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=9; H1(4):=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=10; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; H1(3):=4; Xmin:=0; Xmax:=8; Ymin:=0; Ymax:=6; RETURN STRING({H1,D1}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN H1(2):=""; RETURN STRING({H1,D1}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN SetFreq(H1,2); RETURN STRING({H1,D1}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; SetFreq(H1,2); H1(3):=7; H1(4):=2; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({H1,D1,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;

chart_observations.pie_area_rule: The circle area equals the sum of raw observations: radius sqrt(sum/pi), center [radius+1,radius+1]. Independent datasets and original Autoscale bounds establish the rule.

definition_observations.evidence: Before/after original Symbolic framebuffers on a fresh profile; explicit H1(2):="" changes checked H1 to unchecked. The subsequent SetFreq(H1,2) retains unchecked H1, and Plot reports no checked definition.

frequency_expression_controls.source: EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:={1,2,4}; D2:={2,2,2}; A:=2; RETURN STRING({D1,D2,A,H1}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,2); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,1+1); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,A); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,D2); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,D2+0); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,2*D2); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,{2,2,2}); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN LOCAL ok:=1,n:=-1,m:=-1,s; s:=SetFreq(H1,(2)); IFERR Do1VStats(H1); n:=NbItem; m:=MeanX; THEN ok:=0; END; RETURN STRING({s,H1,ok,n,m}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:=MAKELIST(X,X,1,512); SetFreq(H1,1); H1(3):=1; Hmin:=1; Hmax:=513; Hwidth:=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({SIZE(D1),Hmin,Hmax,Hwidth,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:=MAKELIST(X,X,1,513); SetFreq(H1,1); H1(3):=1; Hmin:=1; Hmax:=514; Hwidth:=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({SIZE(D1),Hmin,Hmax,Hwidth,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
EXPORT STATREF() BEGIN D1:=MAKELIST(X,X,1,1000); SetFreq(H1,1); H1(3):=1; Hmin:=1; Hmax:=1001; Hwidth:=1; STARTVIEW(9); RETURN STRING({SIZE(D1),Hmin,Hmax,Hwidth,Xmin,Xmax,Ymin,Ymax}); END;
